title: Thorax Ontology v0.1
description: Composite domain for Level 1: the heart and the lungs in one scene. Heart Ontology v0.1 is included unchanged; this file adds a thorax root and a v0.1 respiratory vocabulary limited to what the Level 1 data can show (two lungs, five lobes, trachea). It is NOT a validated medical ontology and MUST NOT be presented as clinically authoritative.

provenance.derived_from: General anatomical common knowledge, hand-authored for Level 1. Entity choice follows the structures labelled in the TotalSegmentator v1 dataset (CC BY 4.0); no labels, images or text were imported from it.

external_ontology_alignment.todo: Align respiratory ids with FMA / UBERON alongside the heart alignment.

provenance.review_state: no clinical review has been performed

conventions.entity_id: Respiratory entities are namespaced 'respiratory.' for readability only, as heart entities are 'heart.'.
conventions.anatomy_type: The AnatomyType vocabulary is frozen while research steps run, because the neural feature extractor sizes an input from it (ADR-L1-001). Lungs, lobes and the trachea therefore use 'organ', and semantic_role carries the specific kind.
conventions.lod: As in the heart ontology: each lung is a renderable shell at LOD 0 only, replaced by its lobes from LOD 1.

entities.notes: Organisational root of the Level 1 scene. Not tissue.
